decisions.reason: The minimum quantity lubrication system sits close to the firm's core fluid-handling offer, so keeping it on the modular platform costs little, and the missing website records after 2019 give no evidence that its value has failed to materialize.
The hydrocyclone filter builds on established filtration know-how and serves growing machine-tool demand, so the option stays open at low holding cost while its market value is still unresolved.

The gravity band filter is a staple near-core coolant filtration product that shares components and service infrastructure with the existing range, so dropping it would release few resources and carries no clear negative signal.
